newsitem.title: ITALY: Credito Italiano sells German offshoot.
newsitem.headline: Credito Italiano sells German offshoot.

text.p: Credito Italiano said it was selling its Frankfurt-based offshoot, Credito Italiano Bank AG to the Hypobank group for 124 million marks ($79.7 million).
A statement issued by Credito said the deal would be finalised by the end of December 1996.
Credito said it was strengthening its ties with Hypobank.

"These ties, which already cover all areas of banking, have as a top priority that of providing a better service to Italian clients in the important German market," the statement said. Milan newsroom +392-66102321 ($ = 1.556 German Marks)
